Appendix A - Gift and Entertainment Register
This policy will be communicated to all employees.
Anti-bribery awareness training will be conducted for all employees within three (3) months from the date of issue of this policy, and thereafter for all new employees as part of their induction.
All employees are required to sign an acknowledgement confirming that they have read and understood this policy.
Signed acknowledgements will be retained by Human Resources.
This policy shall be reviewed at least annually by the Compliance Officer, and updated as required to reflect changes in the law or in the Company's operations.
